text:
Mavrik Bourque has no goals in 13 games since joining Nashville from Dallas, and the drought is one of the reasons the Predators' win streak doesn't feel fully settled. He's playing more than 16 minutes a night and getting chances: 3.0 expected goals (the quality of his chances) and 25 shots without one going in.

That part is luck. The worrying part is the chance share. Nashville has only 40% of the five-on-five expected goals with him on the ice, nine points worse than without him. Even in a four-game winning streak, his line has been the one leaking.

He was the 30th pick in 2020 and scored 31 goals over his first 156 games in Dallas. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had 51% of his shots coming off the rush last season and 19% of his setups from behind the net, an unusual mix. Our projection still sees about 15 goals from here. The first one would help, but we'd watch the chance share more.
